title: Factorisation form of the source inverse-pullback exchange square
statement: Let P,Q be schemes and A a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category. For isomorphisms j:Q≅P, a:P≅P, b:Q≅Q, E:Q≅P, suppose b.hom j.hom=j.hom a.hom, j.inv b.inv=a.inv j.inv, b.hom j.hom=E.hom, and j.inv b.inv=E.inv. For every pro-etale sheaf M on P with coefficients in A, the route through the upper-star factor for (b,j), the comparison j^*M→j.inv_*M, the comparison for b, and the lower-star exchange for the inverse commuting square equals the route through the upper-star factor for (j,a), the comparison for a, and the comparison for j. The factors are exactly those in the displayed Lean statement; the common source is E.hom^*M.

proof.text: Use upperStarIsoLowerStarInv_hom_app_trans for (b,j) and (j,a), with the same E and the indicated hom/inverse factorisation witnesses.

The inverse lower-star factor for the first route, followed by the exchange and the inverse reflexive factor, equals the inverse factor of the second route. Check this on sections: combine the three restriction maps using functoriality, then use pullback.hom_ext to identify the canonical iterated-pullback morphisms. Substitute this factor triangle in the two composition identities.

lean.statement:
theorem upperStarIsoLowerStarInv_exchange_factor (A : Type v) [Category.{u + 1} A]
    [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} A] {P Q : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : Q ≅ P) (a : P ≅ P) (b : Q ≅ Q) (E : Q ≅ P)
    (hc : b.hom ≫ j.hom = j.hom ≫ a.hom)
    (hi : j.inv ≫ b.inv = a.inv ≫ j.inv)
    (hE : b.hom ≫ j.hom = E.hom) (hEi : j.inv ≫ b.inv = E.inv)
    (M : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology P) A) :
    (upperStarFactor A hE).hom.app M ≫
      (b.hom)^*[A].map ((upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A j).hom.app M) ≫
      (upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A b).hom.app ((j.inv)_*[A].obj M) ≫
      (lowerStarFactor A hi).hom.app M ≫
      (lowerStarFactor A (rfl : a.inv ≫ j.inv = a.inv ≫ j.inv)).inv.app M =
    (upperStarFactor A (hc.symm.trans hE)).hom.app M ≫
      (j.hom)^*[A].map ((upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A a).hom.app M) ≫
      (upperStarIsoLowerStarInv A j).hom.app ((a.inv)_*[A].obj M)
